external_deps: Claude Code CLI or another agent runtime

review.tagline: Orchestrates many coding agents across git repos with persistent work state
review.summary: Gas Town is a Go CLI (gt) that manages a workspace of git repositories ("rigs") and runs multiple coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini and Cursor against them. Work is tracked as Beads issues grouped into convoys, with state kept in git worktree hooks so it survives agent restarts. A Mayor agent coordinates, while Witness and Deacon watchdogs and a Refinery merge queue handle health and merging.
review.audience: Developers running 5-30 parallel coding agents across git repositories
strengths: 11 built-in agent presets, including claude, codex, copilot, gemini, cursor and opencode
Work state persists in git worktree hooks and the Beads ledger across restarts
Watchdogs detect stuck agents; a Bors-style bisecting queue merges finished work
Minimal mode tracks state without tmux while you run agents manually
weaknesses: Many project-specific terms (Mayor, polecats, rigs, convoys, wasteland) make the learning curve steep
Native install needs Git, Go, bd, Dolt, sqlite3 and tmux 3.0+
Full tmux workflows on Windows need WSL; native Windows is CLI-only
Copilot preset runs with --yolo, so autonomous agents need cost and safety care
needs: Needs Git 2.20+, Go 1.26.2+, Beads (bd) 0.57.0+, Dolt, tmux 3.0+, sqlite3, Claude Code CLI or another agent runtime
Models: Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Gemini, Cursor
